spec.name: Reversal v22
spec.notes: Fade the last move, rebalanced often.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 2.3, annual return 6%, maximum drawdown 3%.

verdict.opinion: The strategy assumes zero transaction costs (costs_bps: 0.0) for a high-frequency rebalancing strategy (rebalance: 1). Given the signal relies on short-term mean reversion (5-day returns), turnover will be significant, and ignoring trading costs will lead to a massive overestimation of net returns. The claimed Sharpe ratio of 2.3 is likely unattainable once realistic slippage and commissions are factored in. I am moving this to paper trading to verify performance under real-world execution costs before committing capital.
